summary: iPower Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) disclosing that wholly owned subsidiary iPower AI LLC received a customer-signed, non-binding letter of intent for a five-year AI equipment services and management relationship. The customer identified an initial fleet of 48 AI computing units, expanding to roughly 396 units during 2027, at a proposed $4,608 per unit per month. Full build-out implies about $1.82 million monthly, or up to $21.90 million annualized; the initial 48 units represent roughly $2.65 million annualized. As a non-binding LOI, no definitive agreement, no board recommendation, and no advisor are named, and no deal terms are fixed.
